changes.description: Tech stack analysis now auto-generates after job collection with AI-enriched summaries
Redesigned company page with cleaner layout, streamlined navigation, and consistent styling
Fixed tech stack generation failing silently due to invalid AI model configuration
Horizontal Gantt-style timeline showing initiative timeframes at a glance
Summary stats row with roles mapped, ongoing count, top category, and confidence distribution
Multi-phase loading with progress bar replaces plain spinner during analysis
Structured AI assessment with bold headline and key risk callout
Category filter bar to show/hide initiative cards by type
Role tags now link to job detail pages and show relevance
Copy Analysis button exports results as formatted Markdown
Multi-expand initiative cards allow side-by-side comparison
Hot Roles on the dashboard now link directly to the job details page instead of the company overview
Feedback-to-code pipeline: accepted feedback automatically creates GitHub Issues with AI-generated specs
Generate Code button in admin panel triggers Claude Opus 4.6 to implement issues on a feature branch and open a draft PR
Admin email notifications when new feedback is submitted
GitHub Issue status comments track implementation progress with links to workflow runs and draft PRs
Add Company page now routes through the feedback dialog for agent-driven setup
Admin panel shows actions for all feedback states including accepted items missing a GitHub Issue
Upgraded strategic analysis and insight chat to Gemini 3.1 Pro for deeper reasoning and more accurate web grounding
Submit feedback directly from the app with AI-powered triage
Contextual back navigation on job detail pages
Release history page and newsletter footer
Rebrand to The Fintech Talent Brief
Stratechery-style analyst briefing format for weekly digests
Intelligence-first dashboard redesign
